description:

Father, hear my prayer, As Christmas is drawing near.
lyrics:
I poured myself a drink. Sat there quietly, doing nothing for a while, until I realized what I really needed wasn't another sip. A prayer, maybe. Father, I haven't been alright today. Some things mattered less than I thought. Some words came out too fast to ever take back. I know I should be wiser, put down what isn't mine to carry, and just breathe. But tonight, I'm tired. So please, just hear me out. Let tomorrow's troubles stay with tomorrow. Each day has enough trouble of its own. They don't need to follow me into sleep. When morning comes, let me get out of bed, pull the curtains open, and believe the road has not run out. I don't need to wake up fearless. If tomorrow can only be a little better, even just a little from You, I'd really need that. And Father, there are others. People living through days a little like mine. Some I know, some I never will, somewhere awake tonight. So if somebody has no words left to pray, let these words be theirs too. Let them sleep. Don't ask them to be brave just yet. Let what they cannot put down feel a little lighter tonight. And when morning comes, let them put their feet on the floor. They don't have to go very far. One step is enough. The way You got me through nights like those, Father, do the same for them tonight. If their tomorrow could only be a little kinder, maybe... give them mine first. Tomorrow, we'll try again. Just one small step further on. Goodnight Father Goodnight Christopher Amen

「讀得懂彼此，卻寫不成我們。」 由 A-BUU 親自作詞、作曲並擔任製作人的《沒寫成以後》，寫下一段關係結束後，才逐漸讀懂的沉默。那些當時沒聽懂的話、沒有送出的問候，以及曾經一起想像的未來，在分開之後有了另一種意思——原來說好的以後，早已沒有自己。 歌曲以「聽、說、讀、寫」串起感情裡理解與錯過的過程。曾經以為足夠了解，就能繼續相愛；直到回頭重讀兩人的故事，才發現讀懂一個人，並不代表能和他走到最後。 編曲以精簡的室內樂編制，讓大提琴與人聲彼此回應，透過層疊和聲與第二旋律，交織出想說與未說的心聲。A-BUU 用溫暖而微帶沙啞的人聲，唱出仍想挽留的遲疑，也唱出不得不接受的結局。 《沒寫成以後》與《如緣》連起告別與重逢之間的時間。前者寫分開之後，如何讀懂一段沒有走到最後的關係；後者則將這份尚未散去的情感，帶到再次相遇的街口。從「讀得懂彼此，卻寫不成我們」，到「隔幾步，卻像隔幾年」，曾經沒有送出的問候，終於在重逢時有了面對對方的機會。 《沒寫成以後》獻給那些仍記得共同約定，卻必須獨自往前的人：我們曾經認真寫過彼此，往後的故事，卻只能各自繼續。而那些沒能一起抵達的以後，也成了日後重逢時，彼此未曾參與的年月。
